Overview

Thousand Oaks is a city in CA with a population of 126,000. Safe Ventura County city with Conejo Valley schools and proximity to beaches. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 285 sunny days a year.
